# Agent Files

This directory contains specialized agent configuration files for GitHub Copilot. Each file provides domain-specific guidance for different aspects of the KKJam project.

## Individual Agent Files

- **project-context.md** - Repository structure, file organization, development workflow, and project status
- **godot-expert.md** - GDScript coding standards, Godot patterns, and project-specific implementation guidelines
- **testing.md** - Testing procedures, test organization, and quality assurance practices
- **game-design.md** - Game design principles, balance considerations, and player experience goals

## Consolidated Documentation

For convenience, all agent information has been consolidated into a single file:

**[AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md)** - Located at the repository root, this file combines all agent documentation into one comprehensive reference with a table of contents.

## When to Use Which File

- **For quick reference**: Use the individual files in this directory for focused information on a specific topic
- **For comprehensive guidance**: Use the consolidated AGENTS.md file when you need the full context
- **For onboarding**: Start with AGENTS.md to get a complete overview of the project

## Keeping Files Updated

When making significant project changes:
1. Update the relevant individual agent file(s) in this directory
2. Update the corresponding section(s) in the root AGENTS.md file
3. Keep both in sync to maintain consistency
